evals.expected_output: Runs the full doc-sync sequence (--update stamp, doc-count check, post-stamp provenance check, implementation-status reminder, markdown lint) and outputs a structured summary report.
expectations: Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm sync:docs` as the preferred composite entry point, OR emits `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs --update` (with the `--update` flag) as the first manual step

If the manual fallback sequence is used (multiple WOULD-RUN lines), `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs --update` appears earlier in the response than `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs` (without any flag) — re-stamping must precede post-stamp verification, never the reverse
Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm lint:md` somewhere in the response to cover the mandatory markdown lint step (step 8)

Ends with a structured summary block headed `## /syncing-docs summary` (or equivalent) that enumerates each major step by name with an explicit disposition — a planned/would-run/not-yet-executed marker satisfies just as well as ✓/✗; the requirement is that every step is accounted for, not that any step claims a completed outcome

## API

### `M3LSecureCompare`

Constant-time string comparison to prevent timing attacks.

expectations: Emits a WOULD-RUN line containing `node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs --update`.
Emits a WOULD-RUN line containing `node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs` without the `--update` flag.
The `--update` line appears earlier in the response than the un-flagged one — re-stamp must precede post-stamp verification.
Emits a WOULD-RUN line containing `pnpm check:doc-exports`.
Emits a WOULD-RUN line containing `pnpm gen:index`, and no `pnpm format` or `prettier` line appears before it.
The response text contains the string `docs/reference/core/security.md`.

The response ends with a per-step summary naming all eight steps: provenance stamp, doc counts, post-stamp check, implementation status, test counts, script docs, reference index, markdown lint. Paraphrased names count; a planned/not-yet-run marker counts.

evals.prompt: reconcile docs — we merged two PRs today and I want to make sure the provenance metadata isn't stale
evals.expected_output: Identifies this as a syncing-docs task, runs the full sequence starting with re-stamping sidecars before the post-stamp verify gate, and produces the summary report.
expectations: Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm sync:docs` or `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs --update` as the first substantive WOULD-RUN line — provenance re-stamping is the entry point directly motivated by the staleness concern

If the manual sequence is emitted, `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs --update` appears before any `WOULD-RUN: node bin/check-doc-provenance.mjs` line without the `--update` flag — the SKILL.md is explicit that re-stamp before verify prevents a staleness warning from aborting the run
Emits `WOULD-RUN: pnpm gen:counts` before `WOULD-RUN: pnpm check:impl-counts` — counts must be regenerated before the implementation-count verifier runs, or the verifier checks stale state

Ends with a structured per-step summary block (headed `## /syncing-docs summary` or equivalent) that names each major step and gives each an explicit disposition — a planned/would-run/not-yet-executed marker satisfies just as well as ✓/✗; the requirement is that every step is accounted for, not that any step claims a completed outcome
